name: Rotary Club of Southport Peter and Jenny Hobart Medical Scholarship
summary: Up to $2,000 for full-time third-year Griffith Doctor of Medicine students.
key: Maximum value is $2,000. Instalments of $1,000 are payable in Trimester 1 and 2.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident or humanitarian visa holder.
Enrolled full-time in your third year of the Doctor of Medicine at Griffith.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
catches: Apply by Monday 19 April 2027, 4pm, for Trimester 1 2027.
Targeted at students experiencing financial difficulties.
